natural_body: Targeted 40% discounts boost acquisition but sharply damage retention.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so simplifying onboarding directly targets the active bottleneck and has prior evidence of improving completion, time-to-value, and durable activation. Promotional pricing could counter the competitor in the short term, but inherited evidence indicates substantial retention harm, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify the two most directly relevant onboarding records before final commitment.
